s0101.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam was remotely appointed grand councillor of the Huguang circuit branch secretariat, granted a tiger tally, and resided at Ezhou.
s0101.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was remotely appointed grand councillor of the Huguang circuit branch secretariat, granted a tiger tally, and resided at Ezhou.

s0102.literal: On gengxu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0102.idiomatic: On gengxu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0103.literal: Fifty-six tribal chiefs of Sukha, Orus, Sayinbuqa, and others were granted seventy-nine bolts of gold-patterned silk each, as well as bows and arrows, saddles, and bridles.
s0103.idiomatic: Fifty-six tribal chiefs of Sukha, Orus, Sayinbuqa, and others were granted 79 bolts of gold-patterned silk each, as well as bows and arrows, saddles, and bridles.

s0104.literal: On renzi day Privy Council officials memorialized: "The three circuits of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Jingzhao had three thousand registered troops; Sangge had them all dismissed to become commoners; now restore their military registration and garrison-farm at Liupan."
s0104.idiomatic: On renzi day Privy Council officials memorialized, "The three circuits of Yan'an, Fengxiang, and Jingzhao had 3,000 registered troops; Sangge had them all dismissed to become commoners; now restore their military registration and garrison-farm at Liupan."

s0106.literal: An edict ordered the Directorate of Waterways to inspect Yellow River dikes and embankments separately, and abolished the River Crossing Office.
s0106.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Directorate of Waterways to inspect Yellow River dikes and embankments separately, and abolished the River Crossing Office.

s0107.literal: On gengshen day field rent of thirteen thousand seven hundred ninety-three hu was remitted for Shaoyang County in Baoqing Circuit.
s0107.idiomatic: On gengshen day field rent of 13,793 hu was remitted for Shaoyang County in Baoqing Circuit.

s0108.literal: On renxu day land, fields, and population that had been attached to monastic quarters under Yang Lianzhenjia were restored.
s0108.idiomatic: On renxu day land, fields, and population that had been attached to monastic quarters under Yang Lianzhenjia were restored.

s0109.literal: Initially Lianzhenjia gave heavy bribes to Sangge and on his own authority opened the Song imperial tombs, taking their jade and precious objects; in all one hundred one tombs were opened, four lives were taken, and stolen and plundered goods amounted to one hundred sixteen thousand two hundred ingots of notes, twenty-three thousand mu of fields, and corresponding amounts of gold, silver, pearls, jade, and precious vessels.
s0109.idiomatic: Initially Lianzhenjia gave heavy bribes to Sangge and on his own authority opened the Song imperial tombs, taking their jade and precious objects; in all 101 tombs were opened, 4 lives were taken, and stolen and plundered goods amounted to 116,200 ingots of notes, 23,000 mu of fields, and corresponding amounts of gold, silver, pearls, jade, and precious vessels.

s0110.literal: Secretariat and censorate officials all requested proper punishment to show the realm; the Emperor still spared his life, but restored his population and land.
s0110.idiomatic: Secretariat and censorate officials all requested proper punishment to show the realm; the Emperor still spared his life, but restored his population and land.

s0111.literal: Longxing Prefecture Circuit suffered famine; two thousand ingots of notes were granted, and grain was again issued for relief.
s0111.idiomatic: Longxing Prefecture Circuit suffered famine; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted, and grain was again issued for relief.

s0112.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day the moon encroached upon Di.
s0112.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day the moon encroached upon Di.

s0113.literal: On jimao day the Directorate of Imperial Regalia was restored to rank three.
s0113.idiomatic: On jimao day the Directorate of Imperial Regalia was restored to rank three.

s0114.literal: The Gansu wine prohibition was relaxed, and a monopoly was placed on its sale.
s0114.idiomatic: The Gansu wine prohibition was relaxed, and a monopoly was placed on its sale.

s0115.literal: On xinsi day the Taiyuan wine prohibition was relaxed, and wine sales were still monopolized.
s0115.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Taiyuan wine prohibition was relaxed, and wine sales were still monopolized.

s0116.literal: On xinmao day schools were established in the various routes of Yunnan; their instructors were filled from Shu scholars.
s0116.idiomatic: On xinmao day schools were established in the various routes of Yunnan; their instructors were filled from Shu scholars.

s0117.literal: Fifth month, on jiawu day Liaoyang's Jurchen and Goryeo suffered famine; an edict ordered Hubuduhua to hasten sea transport to supply them.
s0117.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiawu day Liaoyang's Jurchen and Goryeo suffered famine; an edict ordered Hubuduhua to hasten sea transport to supply them.

s0118.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered: "When Yunnan frontier tribesmen come to court, those not newly submitted may not use relay stations; fodder is not supplied for horses they present."
s0118.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered, "When Yunnan frontier tribesmen come to court, those not newly submitted may not use relay stations; fodder is not supplied for horses they present."

s0119.literal: On dingwei day Ministry Secretariat officials said: "The reckless man Feng Zizhen once wrote poetry praising Sangge, and moreover made extravagant claims; when Sangge fell, he immediately denounced the literary officials for inappropriate wording on a stele; National History Academy compiler Chen Fu exposed his treacherous conduct — we request he be exempted from punishment and sent home."
s0119.idiomatic: On dingwei day ministry secretariat officials said, "The reckless man Feng Zizhen once wrote poetry praising Sangge, and moreover made extravagant claims; when Sangge fell, he immediately denounced the literary officials for inappropriate wording on a stele; National History Academy compiler Chen Fu exposed his treacherous conduct — we request he be exempted from punishment and sent home."

s0120.literal: The Emperor said: "What crime have the literary officials committed!"
s0120.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What crime have the literary officials committed!"

s0121.literal: If praising Sangge is to be a crime, then which court official did not praise him!
s0121.idiomatic: If praising Sangge is to be a crime, then which court official did not praise him!

s0123.literal: An edict ordered that Yang Jukuan and Guo You had died without deserving it; their household property was restored.
s0123.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Yang Jukuan and Guo You had died without deserving it; their household property was restored.

s0124.literal: The Sizhou Pacification Commission was changed to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, subordinate to Huguang Province; an edict instructed its people who had fled in alarm during household inspection to each return to secure livelihood.
s0124.idiomatic: The Sizhou Pacification Commission was changed to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, subordinate to Huguang Province; an edict instructed its people who had fled in alarm during household inspection to each return to secure livelihood.

s0125.literal: Since Shaanxi Salt Transport Commission wine tax and other levies had already entered prefecture and county administration, the various sub-salt offices were abolished, and the Dongping Circuit River Route Intendant Office was also abolished and its affairs transferred to the Directorate of Waterways.
s0125.idiomatic: Since Shaanxi Salt Transport Commission wine tax and other levies had already entered prefecture and county administration, the various sub-salt offices were abolished, and the Dongping Circuit River Route Intendant Office was also abolished and its affairs transferred to the Directorate of Waterways.

s0126.literal: On jiwei day floods struck Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian three counties in Longxing Circuit; field rent of four thousand four hundred sixty-eight shi was remitted.
s0126.idiomatic: On jiwei day floods struck Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian three counties in Longxing Circuit; field rent of 4,468 shi was remitted.

s0127.literal: That month, in Zhending's Zhongshan, Xinle, Pingshan, Huolu, Yuanshi, and Lingshou; Hejian's Cangzhou and Wudi; Jing's Fucheng and Dongguang; and Yidu Circuit's Weizhou Beihai County, insects ate mulberry leaves completely and there were no silkworms.
s0127.idiomatic: That month, in Zhending's Zhongshan, Xinle, Pingshan, Huolu, Yuanshi, and Lingshou; Hejian's Cangzhou and Wudi; Jing's Fucheng and Dongguang; and Yidu Circuit's Weizhou Beihai County, insects ate mulberry leaves completely and there were no silkworms.

s0128.literal: Sixth month, on jiazi day floods struck Pingjiang, Huzhou, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits; Zhiyuan twenty-eighth year field rent of one hundred eighty-four thousand nine hundred twenty-eight shi was remitted.
s0128.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiazi day floods struck Pingjiang, Huzhou, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits; Zhiyuan 28th year field rent of 184,928 shi was remitted.

s0129.literal: On wuchen day an edict allowed monks to consume salt without paying tax.
s0129.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict allowed monks to consume salt without paying tax.

s0130.literal: On jisi day Japan came for mutual trade; wind destroyed three boats, and only one boat reached Qingyuan Circuit.
s0130.idiomatic: On jisi day Japan came for mutual trade; wind destroyed 3 boats, and only 1 boat reached Qingyuan Circuit.

s0131.literal: On renshen day Jiangxi Province officials said: "Zhaoqing and Deqing two circuits and Feng and Lian two prefectures were subordinate to Guangdong in Song times but now to Guangxi — this is inconvenient; we request they be restored to Guangdong."
s0131.idiomatic: On renshen day Jiangxi Province officials said, "Zhaoqing and Deqing two circuits and Feng and Lian two prefectures were subordinate to Guangdong in Song times but now to Guangxi — this is inconvenient; we request they be restored to Guangdong."

s0133.literal: Cerechijerili of Tieqicheng's rear guard led more than three thousand households of his clansmen and retainers to submit.
s0133.idiomatic: Cerechijerili of Tieqicheng's rear guard led more than 3,000 households of his clansmen and retainers to submit.

s0134.literal: On jiaxu day the Registry Treasury was established, at rank five negative, subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Treasuries, storing registered incoming goods.
s0134.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Registry Treasury was established at rank five negative, subordinate to the Directorate of Imperial Treasuries, storing registered incoming goods.

s0135.literal: On bingzi day Huizhou in Daining Circuit had successive years of drought and flood, compounded by heavy corvée; five hundred people died of famine; an edict granted two thousand ingots of notes and one month's grain for relief, and additionally dispatched envoys to reprimand Liaoyang provincial official Asan.
s0135.idiomatic: On bingzi day Huizhou in Daining Circuit had successive years of drought and flood, compounded by heavy corvée; 500 people died of famine; an edict granted 2,000 ingots of notes and 1 month's grain for relief, and additionally dispatched envoys to reprimand Liaoyang provincial official Asan.

s0136.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered that among the newly submitted Hainan four prefectures, five hundred nineteen cave settlements and more than twenty thousand households, Huitong and Ding'an two counties were established, subordinate to Qiongzhou, and their field rent remitted for two years.
s0136.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered that among the newly submitted Hainan four prefectures, 519 cave settlements and more than 20,000 households, Huitong and Ding'an two counties were established, subordinate to Qiongzhou, and their field rent remitted for 2 years.

s0137.literal: On guiwei day, because of the Java campaign, merchants from Two Zhe, Guangdong, and Fujian sailing the seas were temporarily forbidden; after the fleet had sailed they were permitted to proceed as convenient.
s0137.idiomatic: On guiwei day, because of the Java campaign, merchants from Two Zhe, Guangdong, and Fujian sailing the seas were temporarily forbidden; after the fleet had sailed they were permitted to proceed as convenient.

s0138.literal: On dinghai day great floods struck Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping seven circuits; field rent of one million two hundred fifty-seven thousand eight hundred eighty-three shi was remitted.
s0138.idiomatic: On dinghai day great floods struck Huzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping seven circuits; field rent of 1,257,883 shi was remitted.

s0139.literal: On jichou day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.
s0139.idiomatic: On jichou day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.

s0140.literal: The people under Temurtar, Xietu, Negudai, and Kuoku suffered famine; an edict granted four thousand shi of rice to Temurtar and Xietu, and one thousand shi to Negudai and Kuoku, enabling them to relieve the people.
s0140.idiomatic: The people under Temurtar, Xietu, Negudai, and Kuoku suffered famine; an edict granted 4,000 shi of rice to Temurtar and Xietu, and 1,000 shi to Negudai and Kuoku, enabling them to relieve the people.

s0141.literal: Intercalary sixth month, on the xinmao new moon, Shangdu's Military Horse Office was promoted to rank four, as in Dadu.
s0141.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, on the xinmao new moon, Shangdu's Military Horse Office was promoted to rank four, as in Dadu.

s0142.literal: On dingyou day hail damaged crops in Liaoyang, Shenzhou, Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other circuits; field rent of seventy-seven thousand nine hundred eighty-eight shi was remitted.
s0142.idiomatic: On dingyou day hail damaged crops in Liaoyang, Shenzhou, Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other circuits; field rent of 77,988 shi was remitted.

s0143.literal: Floods at Huarong County in Yuezhou; field rent of forty thousand nine hundred sixty-two shi was remitted.
s0143.idiomatic: Floods at Huarong County in Yuezhou; field rent of 40,962 shi was remitted.

s0145.literal: On renyin day Dong'an and Haining were transferred to Huai'an Circuit.
s0145.idiomatic: On renyin day Dong'an and Haining were transferred to Huai'an Circuit.

s0146.literal: An edict stated that Dadu's affairs were numerous; tax levies were transferred to the Transport Commission; when Tongzhou shipbuilding was completed, the intendant office was abolished.
s0146.idiomatic: An edict stated that Dadu's affairs were numerous; tax levies were transferred to the Transport Commission; when Tongzhou shipbuilding was completed, the intendant office was abolished.

s0147.literal: Fujian's annual manufacture of ivory belt plaques was abolished.
s0147.idiomatic: Fujian's annual manufacture of ivory belt plaques was abolished.

s0148.literal: On wushen day Mars encroached upon Dog Country.
s0148.idiomatic: On wushen day Mars encroached upon Dog Country.

s0149.literal: On gengxu day the Muslim Hubumusi offered to sell a large pearl; the Emperor, finding it useless, declined.
s0149.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Muslim Hubumusi offered to sell a large pearl; the Emperor, finding it useless, declined.

s0150.literal: On xinhai day floods at Hexiwu; rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people.
s0150.idiomatic: On xinhai day floods at Hexiwu; rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people.

s0151.literal: Since Henan Province north of the Yangzi had been established, an edict ordered all cities north of the Yangzi subordinate to that province.
s0151.idiomatic: Since Henan Province north of the Yangzi had been established, an edict ordered all cities north of the Yangzi subordinate to that province.

s0152.literal: An edict ordered Hanyang subordinate to Huguang Province.
s0152.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hanyang subordinate to Huguang Province.

s0153.literal: Left River route chief controller Huang Jian said: "Within my jurisdiction Huang Shengxu gathered twenty thousand men and occupied Zhongzhou; I request ten thousand troops and three thousand native soldiers be mobilized, with Liu Guojie ordered to suppress them.
s0153.idiomatic: Left River route chief controller Huang Jian said, "Within my jurisdiction Huang Shengxu gathered 20,000 men and occupied Zhongzhou; I request 10,000 troops and 3,000 native soldiers be mobilized, with Liu Guojie ordered to suppress them.

s0154.literal: I am willing to mobilize ten thousand troops and civilians to follow."
s0154.idiomatic: I am willing to mobilize 10,000 troops and civilians to follow."

s0156.literal: Taiping, Ningguo, Pingjiang, Raozhou, Changzhou, and Huzhou six circuits — the people lacked food; grain was issued for relief.
s0156.idiomatic: Taiping, Ningguo, Pingjiang, Raozhou, Changzhou, and Huzhou six circuits — the people lacked food; grain was issued for relief.

s0157.literal: Goryeo suffered famine; its king dispatched envoys to request grain; an edict granted one hundred thousand shi of rice.
s0157.idiomatic: Goryeo suffered famine; its king sent envoys to request grain; an edict granted 100,000 shi of rice.

s0158.literal: Ministry Secretariat officials said: "This year Jiangnan sea-transport grain reaching the capital totaled one million fifty thousand shi, and that reaching Liaoyang one hundred thirty thousand shi — compared with past years there was no loss, shortage, or deficit."
s0158.idiomatic: Ministry secretariat officials said, "This year Jiangnan sea-transport grain reaching the capital totaled 1,050,000 shi, and that reaching Liaoyang 130,000 shi — compared with past years there was no loss, shortage, or deficit."

s0159.literal: On jiayin day Youjiang's Cen Congyi surrendered; Congyi was aged and ill; an edict ordered his son Yourong to inherit, granted a tiger tally, and made him Military-Civilian Chief Controller of Zhen'an Circuit.
s0159.idiomatic: On jiayin day Youjiang's Cen Congyi surrendered; Congyi was aged and ill; an edict ordered his son Yourong to inherit, granted a tiger tally, and made him Military-Civilian Chief Controller of Zhen'an Circuit.

s0160.literal: Guangnan West Circuit pacification vice commissioner Saipuding and others slandered court policy; Shabuding again funded them; on more than thirty matters heard as rumor they falsely denounced provincial officials; the Emperor, finding this harmful to governance, arrested the evil clique and handed them to officials for punishment according to law.
s0160.idiomatic: Guangnan West Circuit pacification vice commissioner Saipuding and others slandered court policy; Shabuding again funded them; on more than 30 matters heard as rumor they falsely denounced provincial officials; the Emperor, finding this harmful to governance, arrested the evil clique and handed them to officials for punishment according to law.

s0161.literal: On yimao day locusts at Jinan and Panyang.
s0161.idiomatic: On yimao day locusts at Jinan and Panyang.

s0162.literal: That month an edict instructed the surveillance commissions to tour and encourage farming and sericulture.
s0162.idiomatic: That month an edict instructed the surveillance commissions to tour and encourage farming and sericulture.

s0163.literal: Minister of Rites Zhang Lidao and langzhong Waitou, returning as envoys from Annam, brought their envoys Ruan Daifa and He Weiyan to court.
s0163.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhang Lidao and langzhong Waitou, returning as envoys from Annam, brought their envoys Ruan Daifa and He Weiyan to court.

s0164.literal: Chen Ridian submitted a memorial and tablet, restoring the annual tribute.
s0164.idiomatic: Chen Ridian submitted a memorial and tablet, restoring the annual tribute.

s0165.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on the gengshen new moon, an edict ordered Shi Bi to replace Yehheimishi and Gao Xing, leading ten thousand men to campaign against Java, and summoned all three to court.
s0165.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on the gengshen new moon, an edict ordered Shi Bi to replace Yehheimishi and Gao Xing, leading 10,000 men to campaign against Java, and summoned all three to court.

s0166.literal: Envoys were dispatched to investigate those who falsely registered in the Falconry Office to receive grain rations.
s0166.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to investigate those who falsely registered in the Falconry Office to receive grain rations.

s0167.literal: On xinyou day the Hebei-Henan Circuit Surveillance Commission returned its administration to Bianliang.
s0167.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Hebei-Henan Circuit Surveillance Commission returned its administration to Bianliang.

s0168.literal: On guihai day the Dadu city wall was completed.
s0168.idiomatic: On guihai day the Dadu city wall was completed.

s0169.literal: Yeliweili and Shasha had once registered monks, Daoists, Confucians, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman as soldiers; an edict ordered this stopped and that only military registration apply.
s0169.idiomatic: Yeliweili and Shasha had once registered monks, Daoists, Confucians, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman as soldiers; an edict ordered this stopped and that only military registration apply.

s0170.literal: On jiazi day a decree was issued strictly enforcing the prohibition against cattle and horses trampling crops.
s0170.idiomatic: On jiazi day a decree was issued strictly enforcing the prohibition against cattle and horses trampling crops.

s0171.literal: On yichou day Ali wished to repair ships himself and join Zhang Cun with the Java expeditionary army to recruit Champa and Camboja; an edict granted Ali a three-pearl tiger tally and Zhang Cun a one-pearl tiger tally, and additionally remitted three thousand ingots of ortoq notes owed by Ali's father Bober.
s0171.idiomatic: On yichou day Ali wished to repair ships himself and join Zhang Cun with the Java expeditionary army to recruit Champa and Camboja; an edict granted Ali a three-pearl tiger tally and Zhang Cun a one-pearl tiger tally, and additionally remitted 3,000 ingots of ortoq notes owed by Ali's father Bober.

s0172.literal: On bingyin day the Huizhou Circuit Records Office was abolished.
s0172.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Huizhou Circuit Records Office was abolished.

s0173.literal: Garrison-farm rent of twelve thousand eight hundred eleven shi was remitted.
s0173.idiomatic: Garrison-farm rent of 12,811 shi was remitted.

s0174.literal: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Ox.
s0174.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Ox.

s0175.literal: On renshen day altars to soil and grain were built within the Heyi Gate; each altar was five zhang square and five chi high, with white stone as the spirit tablet, decorated with five-direction colored earth; one pine was planted south of the altar, and north of the wall were buried pits and surrounding walls — all following antique models; separate fast halls and thirty-three bays of gate galleries were also built.
s0175.idiomatic: On renshen day altars to soil and grain were built within the Heyi Gate; each altar was 5 zhang square and 5 chi high, with white stone as the spirit tablet, decorated with five-direction colored earth; 1 pine was planted south of the altar, and north of the wall were buried pits and surrounding walls — all following antique models; separate fast halls and 33 bays of gate galleries were also built.

s0176.literal: On wuyin day Li corps hundred-household chief Deng Zhiyuan plotted rebellion and was executed.
s0176.idiomatic: On wuyin day Li corps hundred-household chief Deng Zhiyuan plotted rebellion and was executed.

s0177.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered Yunnan Province to propose prefecture and county officials under its jurisdiction following the Fujian and Two Guang precedents; secretariat and censorate officials would conduct selection by name and report, with appointment edicts immediately granted.
s0177.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered Yunnan Province to propose prefecture and county officials under its jurisdiction following the Fujian and Two Guang precedents; secretariat and censorate officials would conduct selection by name and report, with appointment edicts immediately granted.

s0178.literal: Eighth month, on the jichou new moon, Saipuding was executed; his remaining followers were caned and banished, and their household property was registered.
s0178.idiomatic: Eighth month, on the jichou new moon, Saipuding was executed; his remaining followers were caned and banished, and their household property was registered.

s0179.literal: On renchen day an edict ordered that ritual-music households should still pay levies equally with military relay-station and civilian households.
s0179.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered that ritual-music households should still pay levies equally with military relay-station and civilian households.

s0180.literal: On dingyou day Mercury encroached upon Right Executioner.
s0180.idiomatic: On dingyou day Mercury encroached upon Right Executioner.

s0181.literal: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Fang.
s0181.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Fang.

s0182.literal: On xinchou day Ningxia Prefecture garrison-farming succeeded; its official Torechi was promoted.
s0182.idiomatic: On xinchou day Ningxia Prefecture garrison-farming succeeded; its official Torechi was promoted.

s0183.literal: On renyin day Tangut tuqen and their households, and escapees from Hexi who had entered tribal territories, were registered and seized.
s0183.idiomatic: On renyin day Tangut tuqen and their households, and escapees from Hexi who had entered tribal territories, were registered and seized.

s0184.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0184.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0185.literal: To suppress Zhedong bandit chief Meng Zongba and others, an edict ordered troops stationed in Fujian to obey grand councillor Jelai's command.
s0185.idiomatic: To suppress Zhedong bandit chief Meng Zongba and others, an edict ordered troops stationed in Fujian to obey grand councillor Jelai's command.

s0186.literal: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Right Executioner.
s0186.idiomatic: On yisi day Jupiter encroached upon Right Executioner.

s0187.literal: On bingwu day, following Guo Shoujing's proposal, fourteen canal sections from Tongzhou to Dadu were dredged, employing twenty thousand soldiers and artisans; six canals were also dug to irrigate Changping's waters.
s0187.idiomatic: On bingwu day, following Guo Shoujing's proposal, 14 canal sections from Tongzhou to Dadu were dredged, employing 20,000 soldiers and artisans; 6 canals were also dug to irrigate Changping's waters.

s0188.literal: Since the Guangji Office garrison-farms had suffered both locusts and flood, this year's field rent of nine thousand two hundred eighteen shi was remitted.
s0188.idiomatic: Since the Guangji Office garrison-farms had suffered both locusts and flood, this year's field rent of 9,218 shi was remitted.

s0189.literal: On dingwei day Yehheimishi requested to campaign against Java together with Gao Xing and others; the Emperor said: "Yehheimishi is only familiar with sea routes; maritime affairs should be entrusted to him; military affairs may be delegated to Shi Bi."
s0189.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yehheimishi requested to campaign against Java together with Gao Xing and others; the Emperor said, "Yehheimishi is only familiar with sea routes; maritime affairs should be entrusted to him; military affairs may be delegated to Shi Bi."

s0190.literal: Shi Bi was made Fujian branch secretariat grand councillor to command the expeditionary troops.
s0190.idiomatic: Shi Bi was made Fujian branch secretariat grand councillor to command the expeditionary troops.

s0191.literal: On gengxu day Gaoxian's Gao Xiyun was executed for speaking what was inappropriate.
s0191.idiomatic: On gengxu day Gaoxian's Gao Xiyun was executed for speaking what was inappropriate.

s0192.literal: On renzi day an edict ordered Talachi and Cheng Pengfei to suppress Huang Shengxu; Liu Guojie stationed cavalry to garrison and defend.
s0192.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered Talachi and Cheng Pengfei to suppress Huang Shengxu; Liu Guojie stationed cavalry to garrison and defend.

s0193.literal: On wuwu day Fujian branch secretariat associate administrator Wei Tianyou submitted a plan to mobilize ten thousand civilians to mine mountains and smelt silver, yielding fifteen thousand liang annually.
s0193.idiomatic: On wuwu day Fujian branch secretariat associate administrator Wei Tianyou submitted a plan to mobilize 10,000 civilians to mine mountains and smelt silver, yielding 15,000 liang annually.

s0194.literal: Tianyou levied notes from the people to buy silver for submission to the government but privately kept one hundred seventy ingots; censorate officials requested recovery of the illicit goods and abolition of silver-smelting; this was approved.
s0194.idiomatic: Tianyou levied notes from the people to buy silver for submission to the government but privately kept 170 ingots; censorate officials requested recovery of the illicit goods and abolition of silver-smelting; this was approved.

s0195.literal: The Yan South-Hebei Surveillance Commission was transferred back to administering from Zhending.
s0195.idiomatic: The Yan South-Hebei Surveillance Commission was transferred back to administering from Zhending.

s0196.literal: Shuangcheng at the junction of Goryeo and Jurchen reported famine; an edict ordered the Goryeo king to relieve them with grain from sea transport.
s0196.idiomatic: Shuangcheng at the junction of Goryeo and Jurchen reported famine; an edict ordered the Goryeo king to relieve them with grain from sea transport.

s0197.literal: The Pingluan wine prohibition was relaxed.
s0197.idiomatic: The Pingluan wine prohibition was relaxed.

s0198.literal: An edict ordered Budun and Manggulusimi to lead troops to campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives' State.
s0198.idiomatic: An edict ordered Budun and Manggulusimi to lead troops to campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives' State.

s0199.literal: Ninth month, on the jiwei new moon, investigating censor Pei Ju'an said: "When Yuedimishi encountered bandits rising he did not immediately deploy troops; after the bandits left he extended punishment to common people."
s0199.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the jiwei new moon, investigating censor Pei Ju'an said, "When Yuedimishi encountered bandits rising he did not immediately deploy troops; after the bandits left he extended punishment to common people."

s0200.literal: An edict ordered the censorate and surveillance commission to dispatch officials to investigate.
s0200.idiomatic: An edict ordered the censorate and surveillance commission to dispatch officials to investigate.
